about: Outside-process staging rack: a 48 x 24 x 72 in boltless steel shelving unit (1.5 in slotted angle posts, dark grey, on foot plates; orange step beams round 5/8 in particle-board decks with two centre supports) at three levels labelled HEAT TREAT, ANODIZE and COATING, each holding two 20 x 15 x 9 in stack-and-nest totes, blue for parts going out and red for parts back from the vendor, a traveller in a sleeve on each tote's front; turned shafts, black-oxided blocks, machined aluminium plates and blocks, and yellow powder-coated parts inside. Self-made in Blender (sources/outproc/build_outproc.py) where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.outside_process_rack) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it

outproc_post.about: the shelving's slotted angle posts and foot plates: dark grey powder coat

outproc_beam.about: the shelving's step beams and centre supports: safety orange powder coat

outproc_label.about: the levels' yellow process labels; yellow powder-coated parts back from coating

outproc_tote_blue.about: stack-and-nest totes, blue: parts going out to the vendor

outproc_tote_red.about: stack-and-nest totes, red: parts back from the vendor, to inspect

outproc_paper.about: the travellers taped to the totes

sources_used: the record (48 x 24 x 72 in rack, three shelves; heat treat, coating, anodize) and its placeholder for every post, shelf and tote
boltless rivet shelving catalogues (Edsal, Uline, Global Industrial): slotted angle uprights, step beams carrying particle-board decks, centre supports
stack-and-nest totes (Akro-Mils, Uline): tapered ribbed walls, a rolled rim, end hand holds

unsure.what: the blue-out / red-back tote convention and the level labels are invented to make the rack's job readable
